METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.

2. When learning Hand tools and bench tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand tools and bench tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand tools and bench tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Hand tools and bench tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand tools and bench tools.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Safety in the workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the workshop.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the workshop.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the workshop.

5. When learning Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench.

6. When learning Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.

7. When learning Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.

8. When learning Measuring and marking out tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and marking out tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and marking out tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and marking out tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and marking out tools.

9. When learning Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.

10. When learning Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Introduction to Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Metalwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Metalwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Metalwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Metalwork.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
